question: What is the percentage of players that are under 180 cm who have an overall strength of more than 70?
evidence: percentage refers to DIVIDE(COUNT(height < 180 AND overall_rating > 70),COUNT(id)) * 100
clarification: Count each distinct id only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.overall_rating > 70 THEN t1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) AS percent FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height < 180
gold0: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.overall_rating > 70 THEN t1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t1.id) percent FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height < 180

c.request:
What is the percentage of players that are under 180 cm who have an overall strength of more than 70?
Evidence: percentage refers to DIVIDE(COUNT(height < 180 AND overall_rating > 70),COUNT(id)) * 100
Count each distinct id only once.
c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN P.height < 180 AND PA.overall_rating > 70 THEN P.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT P.id) AS percentage FROM Player AS P INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id

b.request: What percentage of distinct players (each Player id counted once) have both a height under 180 cm and an overall_rating above 70 (using the Player_Attributes strength rating), out of all distinct player ids?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.height < 180 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Player_Attributes pa WHERE pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id AND pa.overall_rating > 70) THEN p.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS percentage FROM Player p

d.request: What is the percentage of players who are under 180 cm in height and have an overall rating above 70, calculated as the number of distinct player ids meeting both conditions divided by the total number of distinct player ids, multiplied by 100?
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.height < 180 AND pa.overall_rating > 70 THEN p.player_api_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS percentage FROM Player p LEFT JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
